status_at_freeze: before feature materialization, native fitting, or test evaluation
purpose: Diagnostic rerun of Exp077 one-stage and 8+8 two-stage XGBoost on Exp031 Protocol A flawed JAAD subsets

representations.early: 161-D joint BBox53 plus BIU-v1 features recomputed from API observations 1--8
representations.full: 182-D no-ego portable Exp077 representation: 161-D joint features plus 21 fixed early/late contrasts

models.two_stage: XGBoost, 125 stage-1 trees plus 125 stage-2 trees; 5-fold track-grouped OOF stage-1 probability during training

settings.pie_to_jaad_zero_shot: reuse exact Exp077 PIE-trained models; no JAAD fitting or calibration
settings.jaad_native: fresh training on Protocol A train, report Protocol A validation, evaluate Protocol A test once

selection: No architecture, hyperparameter, threshold, or model selection based on Protocol A test
pose_policy: Exact (video,pid,frame) identity and frozen Protocol A BBox; no b-suffix aliasing or nearby-frame substitution
known_protocol_artifact: Two train windows contain 16 ordered API observations with a raw-frame gap and are retained unchanged
interpretation: Protocol-sensitivity diagnostic only; not the clean JAAD benchmark and not an exact replay of an unrecovered historical annotation/API snapshot
